newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers fuel oil dips, draws buyers.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers fuel oil dips, draws buyers.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers dipped on Wednesday as barges weakened, bringing in a reasonable level of enquiries, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted as low as $85 a tonne fob by majors, who were the main winners in the fight for trades. Independent suppliers mostly quoted nearer $85.50/$86.
Total ARA volume was at around 15,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices dipped slightly in response to two days of Rotterdam weakness, but at around $91 delivered, few buyers were attracted in.
Mediterranean prices were stable to $1 a tonne stronger.
Most ports were quiet as the weakening futures markets, and the possibility of lower bunkers later this week, persuaded most who could delay to do so.
Fujairah bunkers moved very slightly higher despite a rise of benchmark quotes of almost $2.
